description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

IBM is hiring an Application Developer to analyze requirements and design, develop, test, and support enterprise mainframe applications. The role also supports project delivery, code quality, and testing across IBM and client sites.
Application Developer designing and maintaining enterprise mainframe batch and CICS applications, data workflows, and reports

Responsibilities:
• Perform impact analysis for proposed enhancements to legacy and new applications
• Analyze business requirements and develop technical solutions to meet defined system needs
• Prepare functional and technical design specifications for application enhancements
• Conduct gap analysis and data analysis to support system design and implementation decisions
• Develop and maintain mainframe batch programs, copybooks, jobs, and procedures to support enterprise systems, data processing, and transaction workflows
• Design, modify, and support online mainframe applications using CICS programs and screens
• Generate operational and analytical reports using Job Control Language (JCL), SYNCSORT data sorting utilities, and EZTRIEVE reporting utilities
• Debug, test, and implement application components using standard mainframe debugging and testing tools
• Create and execute unit test data and batch jobs using Job Control Language (JCL)
• Support system, user acceptance, and performance testing by assisting with test data preparation and execution
• Review program code, test cases, and test results to ensure compliance with established coding and quality standards
• Provide technical guidance to project teams through code review and testing feedback
• Coordinate project activities and support delivery timelines, issue resolution, risk management, and scope control

Requirements:
• Master's degree or equivalent in Computer Science or related (employer will accept a Bachelor's degree plus five (5) years of progressive experience in lieu of a Master's degree) and one (1) year of experience as a Software Developer or related
• One (1) year of experience must include utilizing Common Business-Oriented Language (COBOL), Customer Information Control System (CICS), Job Control Language (JCL), Virtual Storage Access Method (VSAM), Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS), z/OS Connect, Agile Methodology
